layout.arrangement: Red bold title centered at top; yellow circular slide-number badge '51' at top-right; two large side-by-side rounded panels below (left = Encoder diagram on peach with a bright-green rectangle filling its right half; right = Decoder diagram on orange with a light-green rectangle on its right half); solid black bar spanning the full slide width at the very bottom.

regions.name: Encoder panel
regions.content: Peach rounded panel, green border, red italic 'Encoder' label top-left; transformer-encoder stack (Add & Norm / Feed Forward / Add & Norm / Multi-Head Attention / Q K V), Nx checkmark, Positional Encoding icon+label, Output Embedding box, red up-arrow with 'Inputs'; solid bright-green rectangle occupies right ~60% of panel

regions.name: Decoder panel
regions.content: Orange rounded panel, green border, green italic 'Decoder' label top-right; from top: Output (yellow) + Probabilities, Softmax, Linear, then container with Add & Norm / Feed Forward / Add & Norm / Multi-Head Attention / Add & Norm / Masked Multi-Head Attention / Q K V; Nx checkmark, Positional Encoding icon+label, Output Embedding, red up-arrow with 'Outputs (shifted right)'; four white callout labels with red block arrows and red dashed ellipses on the orange left portion; light-green rectangle behind the stack on the right

layout.hierarchy: Title is the largest text (red, bold). The two colored panels dominate the body; the decoder panel is visually busier due to callout boxes, dashed ellipses and arrows. Diagram box labels are small bold white/dark text; callout labels are small bold red on white. Black footer bar anchors the base.

visual_elements.description: ENCODER BLOCK DIAGRAM. Peach (#FBE5D6) rounded panel with green (#00B050) border; label 'Encoder' in red bold italic at top-left. A solid bright-green (#00E100) rectangle with no border fills the right ~60% of the panel, full height. In the peach left portion, bottom-to-top: red upward block arrow with black label 'Inputs'; brown (#A0622D) box 'Output Embedding' (white bold text) with a green ✓ at its lower-left; brown circle icon containing a white sine-wave/loop glyph beside black two-line label 'Positional Encoding'; a green ✓ above black label 'Nx' (x subscript) at mid-left; and a rounded light-gray container (thin border) holding, top-to-bottom: blue (#4472C4) box 'Add & Norm' with green ✓ at top-right; gray (#7F7F7F) box 'Feed Forward' with black ✓ at left; blue box 'Add & Norm' with blue ✓ at right; pink (#FFC7CE) box with red border 'Multi-Head Attention' (dark-red text) with red ✓ at right; three small circles at bottom labeled Q (red), K (blue), V (green). Thin yellow highlight lines form a partial rectangle around the top of the stack and extend right across the green rectangle. Thin vertical connectors join stack to embedding box.

DECODER BLOCK DIAGRAM. Orange (#ED7D31) rounded panel with green (#00B050) border; label 'Decoder' in green bold italic at top-right. Light-green (#CCFFCC) rectangle covers the right ~55% of the panel where the stack sits. Top-to-bottom: yellow (#FFFF00) box 'Output' (black text) with red upward block arrow at its left and black label 'Probabilities' at its right; teal (#66CCCC) box 'Softmax' encircled by a red dashed ellipse; teal box 'Linear' encircled by a red dashed ellipse; large rounded container (light fill, thin border, thin yellow accent line on right edge) holding top-to-bottom: blue 'Add & Norm' (green ✓ at left), gray 'Feed Forward' (black ✓ at left), blue 'Add & Norm', pink red-bordered 'Multi-Head Attention' (red ✓ at right) encircled by red dashed ellipse, blue 'Add & Norm' (blue ✓ at right), purple (#C9A0DC) 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' (green ✓ at right) with red '≈' symbol at its left, and three small circles Q (red), K (blue), V (green) at bottom; below container: green ✓ with black 'Nx' at right side; brown circle icon with white sine-wave glyph and black two-line label 'Positional Encoding' at right; brown 'Output Embedding' box (white text) with dark-brown ✓ at its left; red upward block arrow at bottom with black label 'Outputs (shifted right)'. Small colored connector dots (red/blue/green) and short arrows join the stacked boxes.

Four white rectangular callout labels with red bold text, each paired with a red right-pointing block arrow and (for the top two and the attention one) a red dashed ellipse around the target: 'Decoder Only' → dashed ellipse around 'Softmax'; 'Decoder Only' → dashed ellipse around 'Linear'; 'Encoder – Decoder Attention' (stacked 3 lines) → dashed ellipse around 'Multi-Head Attention'; 'Adding Mask' → points at 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' (no ellipse). All sit in the orange left portion of the decoder panel.

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title: bold, ~36–40 pt, red, title case with spaced en dash. Panel labels 'Encoder'/'Decoder': bold italic ~16–18 pt (red / green). Diagram box labels: bold ~10–11 pt, white on dark fills, dark red on pink, black on yellow/teal. Callout labels: bold red ~10–11 pt on white rectangles. 'Nx' rendered as N with subscript-style x. Multi-word box labels wrap onto 2–3 lines (e.g., 'Feed Forward', 'Masked / Multi-Head / Attention'). No serif fonts, no all-caps styling.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built; no partial reveal detected. The bright-green rectangle covering the encoder's right half looks like a static annotation/masking shape rather than a mid-build state.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide; set background light gray #E8E8E8 with a thin white outer frame; add a black rectangle across the full bottom edge (~4% height). 2. Add centered title text box at top: 'Encoder – Decoder Transformer', Arial bold 36 pt, color #C00000. 3. Add a yellow (#FFFF00) circle with thin dark outline at top-right containing bold black '51' (14 pt). 4. ENCODER PANEL: rounded rectangle at x≈13%, y≈17%, w≈33%, h≈76%; fill #FBE5D6, border #00B050 (2 pt); label 'Encoder' red bold italic 16 pt at its top-left. 5. Inside, place a borderless bright-green (#00E100) rectangle covering the panel's right ~60%, full height. 6. Build the encoder stack (rounded light-gray container ~1.9 in wide) top-to-bottom: blue #4472C4 box 'Add & Norm' (white bold 10 pt), gray #7F7F7F box 'Feed Forward', blue box 'Add & Norm', pink #FFC7CE box with 1.5 pt red border 'Multi-Head Attention' (dark-red text); add three 0.25 in circles below labeled Q (red), K (blue), V (green). Add checkmarks: green ✓ top-right of top 'Add & Norm', black ✓ left of 'Feed Forward', blue ✓ right of middle 'Add & Norm', red ✓ right of 'Multi-Head Attention'. Draw thin yellow lines forming a partial rectangle around the stack top extending right into the green rectangle. 7. Below the stack: brown #A0622D box 'Output Embedding' (white bold 10 pt) with green ✓ at lower-left; brown circle with white sine-wave glyph beside black two-line label 'Positional Encoding'; green ✓ above black 'Nx' at mid-left; red up block arrow below the box with black label 'Inputs'; connect stack and embedding with thin arrows. 8. DECODER PANEL: rounded rectangle at x≈58%, y≈17%, w≈34%, h≈76%; fill #ED7D31, border #00B050; label 'Decoder' green (#00A050) bold italic 16 pt at top-right; borderless light-green #CCFFCC rectangle covering right ~55%. 9. Decoder column top-to-bottom: yellow #FFFF00 box 'Output' (black text) with red up block arrow at left and black 'Probabilities' at right; teal #66CCCC boxes 'Softmax' then 'Linear'; large rounded container holding blue 'Add & Norm' (green ✓ left), gray 'Feed Forward' (black ✓ left), blue 'Add & Norm', pink red-bordered 'Multi-Head Attention' (red ✓ right), blue 'Add & Norm' (blue ✓ right), purple #C9A0DC 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' (green ✓ right) with red '≈' at its left, and Q/K/V circles (red/blue/green) at bottom; add thin yellow accent line on the container's right edge. 10. Below the container: green ✓ + black 'Nx' at right; brown circle sine icon with black two-line 'Positional Encoding' at right; brown 'Output Embedding' box with dark-brown ✓ at left; red up block arrow with black label 'Outputs (shifted right)' beneath. 11. CALLOUTS: four white rectangles with red bold 10 pt text and red right-pointing block arrows: 'Decoder Only' → red dashed ellipse around 'Softmax'; 'Decoder Only' → red dashed ellipse around 'Linear'; 'Encoder – Decoder Attention' (3 lines) → red dashed ellipse around 'Multi-Head Attention'; 'Adding Mask' → arrow to 'Masked Multi-Head Attention'. 12. Join all stacked boxes with thin dark connector arrows and add small red/blue/green dots on connectors as in the original.
